title: Real attack: Empire Invoke-PsExec (OTRF)
description: Recorded in a lab Windows domain by the OTRF Security Datasets project. An attacker with a foothold on WORKSTATION5 uses the Empire framework to move to WORKSTATION6. Thousands of normal background events surround the attack.
chart_note: Real recordings are short: about two minutes of a busy Windows network.
directory_note: Lab environment: the dataset does not include real job roles.
